description: This file is a configuration source file for the AUTOSAR OS on an MPC5604B microcontroller. It contains definitions for applications, counters, alarms, tasks, hooks, ISRs, and other OS parameters, primarily consisting of macro invocations and variable initializations.

methods.name: GEN_APPLICATION_HEAD
methods.description: Macro defining the application configuration, such as ID, name, and associated hooks.

methods.name: GEN_APPLICATION
methods.description: Macro used within GEN_APPLICATION_HEAD to declare an application entity.

methods.name: GEN_COUNTER
methods.description: Macro used within GEN_COUNTER_HEAD to declare a counter with specific parameters.

methods.name: GEN_ALARM_AUTOSTART
methods.description: Macro to declare an auto-start alarm with specified timing parameters.

methods.name: GEN_ALARM
methods.description: Macro to declare an alarm entity.

methods.name: DECLARE_STACK
methods.description: Macro to declare stack memory for tasks.

methods.name: GEN_TASK_HEAD
methods.description: Macro defining task configurations, including priorities, scheduling, and resource management.

methods.name: GEN_BTASK
methods.description: Macro used to define a basic task.

methods.name: GEN_ETASK
methods.description: Macro used to define an extended task.

methods.name: GEN_HOOKS
methods.description: Macro to define startup, shutdown, error, and other hooks.

methods.name: GEN_ISR_MAP
methods.description: Macro to define the ISR vector mapping.
